description: After Show older activity, focus moves to the first newly shown event (correct), but article.event has no visible focus style, and the "Showing N of M" counter has scrolled out of view. Sighted users cannot see where the older batch begins.
expected: A visible focus ring or divider such as "Older activity" at the boundary.
actual: No visual boundary or focus indication.
suggested_fix: Style article.event:focus-visible, and/or insert a boundary marker at each page join.

description: Long runs of identical edits (280 consecutive "changed the priority of Audit tax-rate lookups" rows) are listed one by one and push meaningful events several pages back.
expected: Consecutive edits by one Actor on one task are collapsed ("Dev Raman changed the priority 280 times").
suggested_fix: Group adjacent same-actor/same-subject/same-field events in the feed renderer.
